methodology_note: OperatingCashFlow is used as the FCF proxy per company instruction. For ORA/DMF retirement village operators, OCF includes resident ORA receipts which partly represent capital flows. This results in high absolute intrinsic values relative to current price, reflecting the market's significant discount for debt risk, NZ property market uncertainty, and Australian execution risk. The DCF is mathematically correct; the gap to market price reflects non-DCF concerns the market is pricing.

historical_growth.eps_note: EPS CAGRs use UnderlyingProfit (strips out fair value movements). Basic EPS CAGR is distorted: FY2022 NPAT $543.7m included large fair value gains; FY2025 EPS 108.12c vs FY2022 238.2c reflects this distortion.
historical_growth.equity_note: Equity/NTA CAGR is elevated by NZ property revaluations. OCF CAGR is used as primary growth rate as it better reflects cash-generative capacity for DCF purposes.

base.description: Historical OCF growth decelerating toward terminal. Steady NZ operations, modest Australia contribution by Y5, NZ property market gradual recovery.

bull.description: Strong NZ demographic tailwind, Australia scaling to 300 units/year by FY27, NZ property market recovery supports ORA pricing, care ORA conversion drives profitability, interest rate cuts reduce finance costs.

bear.description: NZ property market stagnation, Australia delays and cost overruns, regulatory reform disruption (mandatory buy-back), care funding shortfalls, debt pressure limiting build rate.

base.entry_price_note: Current price (NZD 10.66) is 61.7% below this entry price, implying buying today would exceed 15% CAGR target to terminal value under base case

sensitivity.matrix_note: Intrinsic value per share (NZD) using base case growth rates [15,13,11,9,7%] across WACC and terminal growth combinations. All 25 scenarios show intrinsic value materially above current price of NZD 10.66.

nta_cross_check.note: Stock trades at a 22.5% discount to NTA of NZD 13.75/share. NTA is an asset-based floor; DCF intrinsic values are substantially higher, reflecting the going-concern earnings power of the OCF-generating portfolio.
